data.name: Shravya
data.gender_notes: Shravya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who has a deep intellect and great grace. The name Shravya carries the meaning “Intellect, Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Shravya usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the deep understanding and the ability to express oneself with grace and beauty
data.etymology: Shravya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shravya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shravya reflects the deep intellectual tradition of Hindu thought, and implies a deep love for knowledge and learning. It is a name that aligns with the value prized in Indian culture, where wisdom is highly revered and considered a great virtue.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, deep intellect and transcendent consciousness are interconnected. Each individual has the potential to tap into the divine wisdom within. The name Shravya symbolizes the inner quest for knowledge and spiritual growth, and reminds us to always keep our mind open to higher learning, both in the world and in our own Selves.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shravya, meaning 'he who is heard or listened to', symbolizes the quest for inner wisdom and knowledge. It highlights the importance of attentively receiving and absorbing spiritual teachings.
